title: Ken Masters' hardest choice in Street Fighter 6
subject: ken
description:
Would you have walked away from your family to protect them? 👇

Why Ken Masters vanished after being framed by JP in Street Fighter 6. Spoilers for Street Fighter 6.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ken Masters lost everything, and then he chose to disappear.
Framed by JP for terror attacks in Nayshall, he lost his fortune, his foundation and his good name.
He could have run home to his wife Eliza and his son Mel.
But here's what hurts most. He stayed away, so the people hunting him would never reach them.
Now he works construction under the radar, and even Ryu and Guile can only help from a distance.
He still trains, still asks what he's fighting for, and still relives the night
